Class MockServerHttpRequest

java.lang.Object
org.springframework.http.server.reactive.AbstractServerHttpRequest
org.springframework.mock.http.server.reactive.MockServerHttpRequest
All Implemented Interfaces:
HttpMessage, HttpRequest, ReactiveHttpInputMessage, ServerHttpRequest
public final class MockServerHttpRequest extends AbstractServerHttpRequest
用于测试的 `AbstractServerHttpRequest` 模拟扩展，无需实际服务器即可使用。请使用静态方法获取构建器。
Since:
5.0
Author:
Rossen Stoyanchev

    • initCookies

      protected MultiValueMap<String, HttpCookie> initCookies()
      描述从类复制：AbstractServerHttpRequest
      Obtain the cookies from the underlying "native" request and adapt those to an HttpCookie map. The return value is turned into an immutable map and cached.

      注意，此方法会在访问AbstractServerHttpRequest.getCookies()时懒加载调用。如果底层“原生”请求未提供线程安全的 Cookie 数据访问，子类应同步 Cookie 初始化。

      Specified by:
      `AbstractServerHttpRequest` 类中的 initCookies

    • getNativeRequest

      public <T> T getNativeRequest()
      描述从类复制：AbstractServerHttpRequest
      Return the underlying server response.

      注意： 此接口主要暴露给内部框架使用，例如 spring-webflux 模块中的 WebSocket 升级。
